capabilities: Manage nested to-do lists with colors and icons
Set optional start and due dates with or without time
Encrypt private lists with AES-256-GCM and auto-lock
Sync tasks with Google, Yandex and CalDAV calendars
Reorder tasks by drag and drop or sorting
disambiguation: Despite the name, it is a plain to-do list manager, not a game or RPG quest tracker.
extras: No telemetry, no ads; works offline with no account; data stored in the vault's Quests folder (quests.json plus attachments) and merged per task across devices; MIT license, bundles ical.js (MPL 2.0); a forgotten private-list password cannot be recovered.
problem: Obsidian's checkbox tasks offer no nested lists, password-protected encrypted lists, or two-way sync with external calendars.

relations.evidence: Google Calendar (with your own OAuth "Desktop app" client, see the steps above)
Yandex Calendar and other CalDAV servers (iCloud, Nextcloud, Fastmail)
Tasks can be sent to CalDAV and Google calendars as events

requires.name: Account with a calendar service (Google, Yandex, iCloud, etc.)
CalDAV server or .ics feed for calendar sync

summary: To-do plugin with nested lists, encrypted private lists, start/due dates, attachments, and Google, Yandex and CalDAV calendar sync.
